name: Duo Quest
description:
About This Game

Your bond is your greatest weapon! Duo Quest blends strategic deck building with deep conversational social gameplay to create the perfect co-op game for you to play with a friend or partner.

Duo Quest puts you in the shoes of two adventurers set on a quest to defeat the fearsome Demon King who has laid waste to the lands with his evil invention - The Bondbreaker. As the Kingdom’s last hope, you must learn to wield the Duo Energy - a weapon whose strength is tied to its user's bond.

With many monsters to fight, and hundreds of questions to test your relationship with, Duo Quest was made solely for co-op, where gamers and non-gamers can play together through an immersive and quirky 8-bit fantasy world.

Features

  • Designed for Co-Op: Team up with your friend or partner - Duo Quest’s easy to pick up gameplay is the perfect excuse to get your non-gamer friends to play games with you.

  • Quirky and Thought-Provoking Questions: Learn more about your partner and test your relationship! Discover 1000+ fun questions where you and your partner must match answers to defeat your enemies. With 20+ question themes to discover, every choice shapes your strategy - pick wisely to unlock powerful combo cards and claim victory!

  • Procedurally Generated Levels: Explore Duo Quests ever-changing levels, where no run is the same! Take a gamble with randomised routes to battle your way to epic boss battles. Replay levels to discover secrets and unlock every powerful card!

  • Roguelite Deck Building: Unlock hundreds of cards with every new run to add to your custom deck and forge your own strategy against your enemies.

  • Classes: Unlock 5 exciting classes, each with unique card sets and forge your own path to victory!

  • Mysterious Artifacts: Discover powerful items known as Artifacts through your runs, and enhance your playstyle by turning the odds in your favour.
short_desc: Your bond is your greatest weapon! Team up with a friend to battle monsters by answering quirky and thought-provoking questions about each other, while building decks and exploring an ever-changing world. Can your relationship survive the ultimate test?
